finding.claim: has_agents uses os.path.lexists, so an AGENTS.md that exists but is not a regular file (a directory) makes init write a CLAUDE.md holding only @AGENTS.md, with no block anywhere and no warning; before this change that repository got a CLAUDE.md with the block. A CLAUDE.md that imports @AGENTS.md beside such an AGENTS.md is likewise skipped in silence. Gate the import case on AGENTS.md being a file (or warn when it is not).

fixes.change: An AGENTS.md that is not a regular file (and not an unsafe link) counts as absent with a warning, so CLAUDE.md gets the block instead of an import that loads nothing, and an importing CLAUDE.md beside it is not skipped silently.
An AGENTS.md folder gives CLAUDE.md the block and a warning, alone and beside a CLAUDE.md that imports it.
